\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{فرض} \fa{کردن} (farz kardan)}{فرض کردن (farz kardan)}]{\fa{فرض} \fa{کردن} (farz kardan) — to suppose, to assume}

\label{lesson:FA-C391-farz-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for unless, then the Persian for otherwise.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{فرض} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{فرض} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{farz kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to suppose, to assume\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{من} \fa{فرض} \fa{کردم} \fa{که} \fa{او} \fa{خبر} \fa{دارد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{man farz kardam ke u khabar dârad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I assumed that he knew.
\end{quote}

\emph{Farz} \textquotedblleft{}assumption\textquotedblright{} + \emph{kardan} (stem \emph{kon-}). \emph{Farz konim ke} … — let us suppose that … .

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{فرض}} was borrowed from Arabic \emph{farḍ} (EtymDB), a word for something laid down; in Persian it means an assumption. \emph{Kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{} is inherited Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{farz kardan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{farz kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{farz kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for unless, then the Persian for otherwise, then say \emph{farz kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{فرض} \fa{کردن} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To suppose, to assume\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{فرضیه} (farziye)}{فرضیه (farziye)}]{\fa{فرضیه} (farziye) — a hypothesis}

\label{lesson:FA-C391-farziye}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for otherwise, then the Persian for to suppose.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{فرضیه}}
\textbf{\fa{فرضیه}} (\emph{farziye}) — \textquotedblleft{}a hypothesis\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{دانشمندها} \fa{این} \fa{فرضیه} \fa{را} \fa{آزمایش} \fa{کردند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{dâneshmandhâ in farziye râ âzmâyesh kardand.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The scientists tested this hypothesis.
\end{quote}

\emph{Farz} \textquotedblleft{}assumption\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-iye}. Plural \emph{farziyehâ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{فرضیه}} is built on \emph{farz} \textquotedblleft{}assumption\textquotedblright{}, from Arabic \emph{farḍ} (EtymDB), with the ending \emph{-iye}, as in \emph{nazariye} \textquotedblleft{}theory\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{farziye}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{farziye}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{farziye}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for otherwise, then the Persian for to suppose, then say \emph{farziye} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{فرضیه} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A hypothesis\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{چنانچه} (chenânche)}{چنانچه (chenânche)}]{\fa{چنانچه} (chenânche) — if (formal), in case}

\label{lesson:FA-C391-chenanche}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to suppose, then the Persian for a hypothesis.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{چنانچه}}
\textbf{\fa{چنانچه}} (\emph{chenânche}) — \textquotedblleft{}if (formal), in case\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{چنانچه} \fa{هوا} \fa{خوب} \fa{باشد،} \fa{مسابقه} \fa{برگزار} \fa{میشود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{chenânche havâ khub bâshad, mosâbeqe bargozâr mishavad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the weather is good, the match will be held.
\end{quote}

Formal and written, like \emph{agar}; it takes the subjunctive.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{چنانچه}} is a native Persian compound built from \emph{chenân} \textquotedblleft{}so, in that way\textquotedblright{} and \emph{che} \textquotedblleft{}what\textquotedblright{}: in such a way that, if.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chenânche}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chenânche}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{chenânche}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to suppose, then the Persian for a hypothesis, then say \emph{chenânche} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{چنانچه} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}If (formal), in case\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه} (bâ vojud-e inke)}{با وجود اینکه (bâ vojud-e inke)}]{\fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه} (bâ vojud-e inke) — even though, despite the fact that}

\label{lesson:FA-C391-ba-vojud-e-inke}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a hypothesis, then the Persian for if.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه}}
\textbf{\fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه}} (\emph{bâ vojud-e inke}) — \textquotedblleft{}even though, despite the fact that\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه} \fa{باران} \fa{میآمد،} \fa{بیرون} \fa{رفتیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{bâ vojud-e inke bârân miâmad, birun raftim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Even though it was raining, we went out.
\end{quote}

It takes an indicative clause, like \emph{agarche}. With a noun, \emph{bâ vojud-e} alone.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه}} is literally \textquotedblleft{}with the existence of the fact that\textquotedblright{}: \emph{vojud} comes from Arabic \emph{wujūd} \textquotedblleft{}existence\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB), and \emph{bâ} \textquotedblleft{}with\textquotedblright{} and \emph{inke} \textquotedblleft{}that\textquotedblright{} are Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bâ vojud-e inke}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bâ vojud-e inke}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{bâ vojud-e inke}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a hypothesis, then the Persian for if, then say \emph{bâ vojud-e inke} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Even though, despite the fact that\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{خیال} \fa{کردن} (khiyâl kardan)}{خیال کردن (khiyâl kardan)}]{\fa{خیال} \fa{کردن} (khiyâl kardan) — to imagine; to think wrongly}

\label{lesson:FA-C391-khiyal-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for if, then the Persian for even though.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{خیال} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{خیال} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{khiyâl kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to imagine; to think wrongly\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{خیال} \fa{کردم} \fa{او} \fa{رفته} \fa{است،} \fa{اما} \fa{خانه} \fa{بود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{khiyâl kardam u rafte ast, ammâ khâne bud.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I thought he had gone, but he was at home.
\end{quote}

Often a belief that turns out wrong. \emph{Khiyâl} \textquotedblleft{}imagination\textquotedblright{} + \emph{kardan}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{خیال}} was borrowed from Arabic \emph{khayāl} \textquotedblleft{}imagination\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB); with the inherited verb \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}, it means to imagine, often wrongly.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khiyâl kardan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khiyâl kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{khiyâl kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for if, then the Persian for even though, then say \emph{khiyâl kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 384–391 — a review}

\label{lesson:FA-R391-review-384-391}



\begin{quote}
Say the Persian for a strike and a union.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a strike, a union, to work hard, to succeed, to be defeated
  \item a society, social, a generation, elderly, a religion
  \item equality, inequality, justice, poverty, wealth
  \item migration, a migrant, a minority, a majority, discrimination
  \item pollution, recycling, to recycle, consumption, to consume
  \item a volunteer, a charity, peace, violence, addiction
  \item provided that, in the event that, in case of, unless, otherwise
  \item to suppose, a hypothesis, if, even though, to imagine
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A strike? (\textbf{\fa{اعتصاب}}.) A union? (\textbf{\fa{اتحادیه}}.) To work hard? (\textbf{\fa{زحمت} \fa{کشیدن}}.) To succeed? (\textbf{\fa{موفق} \fa{شدن}}.) To be defeated? (\textbf{\fa{شکست} \fa{خوردن}}.) A society? (\textbf{\fa{جامعه}}.) Social? (\textbf{\fa{اجتماعی}}.) A generation? (\textbf{\fa{نسل}}.) Elderly? (\textbf{\fa{سالمند}}.) A religion? (\textbf{\fa{مذهب}}.) Equality? (\textbf{\fa{برابری}}.) Inequality? (\textbf{\fa{نابرابری}}.) Justice? (\textbf{\fa{عدالت}}.) Poverty? (\textbf{\fa{فقر}}.) Wealth? (\textbf{\fa{ثروت}}.) Migration? (\textbf{\fa{مهاجرت}}.) A migrant? (\textbf{\fa{مهاجر}}.) A minority? (\textbf{\fa{اقلیت}}.) A majority? (\textbf{\fa{اکثریت}}.) Discrimination? (\textbf{\fa{تبعیض}}.) Pollution? (\textbf{\fa{آلودگی}}.) Recycling? (\textbf{\fa{بازیافت}}.) To recycle? (\textbf{\fa{بازیافت} \fa{کردن}}.) Consumption? (\textbf{\fa{مصرف}}.) To consume? (\textbf{\fa{مصرف} \fa{کردن}}.) A volunteer? (\textbf{\fa{داوطلب}}.) A charity? (\textbf{\fa{خیریه}}.) Peace? (\textbf{\fa{صلح}}.) Violence? (\textbf{\fa{خشونت}}.) Addiction? (\textbf{\fa{اعتیاد}}.) Provided that? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{شرط} \fa{اینکه}}.) In the event that? (\textbf{\fa{در} \fa{صورتی} \fa{که}}.) In case of? (\textbf{\fa{در} \fa{صورت}}.) Unless? (\textbf{\fa{مگر} \fa{اینکه}}.) Otherwise? (\textbf{\fa{در} \fa{غیر} \fa{این} \fa{صورت}}.) To suppose? (\textbf{\fa{فرض} \fa{کردن}}.) A hypothesis? (\textbf{\fa{فرضیه}}.) If? (\textbf{\fa{چنانچه}}.) Even though? (\textbf{\fa{با} \fa{وجود} \fa{اینکه}}.) To imagine? (\textbf{\fa{خیال} \fa{کردن}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
